title: Activity event register
description: Every activity event the server records, or that someone has asked for. See .ai/plans/activity-flow.md.

kind.description: Stable id, snake_case, past tense. What the table stores; never rename one that is recording.

label.description: The words on the flow, e.g. "Started a Go run".

icon.description: Optional: an emoji drawn in place of the label on the Activity tab, to save room. The label and time show on hover.

shows.description: line: the dot did it. branch: someone else did, shown off this dot's line.

branchFrom.description: For a branch: the kind of the stop it hangs off.

route.description: "METHOD /route/{pattern}", exactly as the endpoint's route attribute. Required when recording.

status.description: wanted: asked for, not built; the server ignores it. recording: the server records it.

describe.description: Plain words for a wanted event, when the route isn't known yet.

notes.description: Anything the builder needs: what a controller must set, dedupe, detail fields.
